about_the_game:
Introducing Furball Blitz!

Welcome to Furball Blitz — where cute animal soldiers charge through space with grit, guns, and just a bit of madness.

Team up with these not-so-fluffy warriors in a chaotic, bullet-soaked, rogue-lite shooter where every run is a fight to survive — and escape alive.

Each playthrough offers a new adventure, where you'll wield different weapons and navigate dangerous zones filled with incoming bullets!

Weapons, weapons, more weapons!

The armory boasts over 50 unique weapons, ranked across five performance tiers.

From pistols and bazookas to cluster bombs, high-caliber rifles, drone bombers... even the infamous Mini Nuke and MIRVs!

These wildly unconventional weapons — the kind you'd never expect in a typical FPS — charge into battle with a perfectly straight face.

Carry up to three at a time, and unleash chaos with combos only you could come up with.

Power Up, Inside and Out

During combat

  • Enhance weapons with random modifiers.
    Add homing guidance to piercing weapons, or increase the blast radius on your bazooka!

  • Stack powerful relics for crazy synergies.
    Grab power-ups and mix relics to amplify your strengths — and patch up your weaknesses.

  • Use active items strategically.
    Throw bombs, replenish ammo, boost your firepower, deploy emergency shields — and turn the tide in a flash.

Outside of combat,

  • Grow stronger with every run by investing in a trait tree that offers permanent upgrades and playstyle customization.

Don't fight alone!

Call in support drones mid-battle to refill your ammo and patch up your health, and equip D.O.G.G.I.E with extra weapons and send him into the fray.

D.O.G.G.I.E provides cover fire, stores your spare weapons, and always has your back.

And of course, duo multiplayer is fully supported.

Have fun alone or with a friend.

Farm and battle together.

Upcoming Content

While the current version features only the roguelike dungeon crawling mode, several exciting new modes are on the way:

  • Defense Mode
    Team up and hold the line against waves of enemies.

  • Survivor Mode
    Fend off endless hordes and grow stronger with every second.

  • Deathmatch Mode
    Prove your skills in intense PvP showdowns.

All modes will support duo co-op, so you can always bring a friend along for the ride.

Plus, new weapons, relics, and gameplay content will continue to roll out with future updates.

And most importantly — we want to hear from you!

Furball Blitz is built with the community, and your feedback and ideas truly shape the future of the game.

Share your thoughts anytime — we're always listening.

Head to the battlefield now!

The battlefield is chaotic. The soldiers are adorable.

And under your command, they'll become unstoppable warriors.

Start your very own cute — and utterly explosive — legend in Furball Blitz!
